parts.title: All Aboard
parts.text: Ines, Kofi, and Wendy stood on the platform with Grandpa. A loud **whistle** blew, and the long train rolled in. The **conductor** smiled and checked their tickets. “All aboard!” he called. The children climbed into a **carriage** and found seats by the window.

parts.title: Down the Tracks
parts.text: The train began to **shudder**, and then it began to **chug** out of the station. The wheels began to **clack** on the tracks. Soon the houses outside were just a **blur**. A bird seemed to **whiz** past the window.

parts.title: Through the Hills
parts.text: The train dove into a dark **tunnel**, and Wendy held her breath. Then the light came back, and they saw the green **countryside**, with farms, cows, and a red barn. Kofi looked back and saw a little red **caboose** at the end of the train. Later, the train stopped for a signal, and the engine sat **idle** for a few minutes.

parts.title: The Last Stop
parts.text: At the last stop, the children thanked the kind man in the blue hat. They had seen so much on one trip. Grandpa said a journey can be as fun as the place you are going.

definitions.meaning1: To shake suddenly because of cold, fear, or a bump. Example: The old bus began to shudder when it started.
definitions.meaning2: A sudden shake. Example: A shudder ran through the train.
definitions.studentChallenge: I felt myself ___ when the cold wind hit me.

definitions.meaning1: A high, sharp sound made by blowing. Example: We heard the whistle of the train.
definitions.meaning2: To make a high sound by blowing air through your lips. Example: I like to whistle a happy song.
definitions.studentChallenge: Dad will ___ to call the dog.

definitions.meaning1: A person who checks tickets and helps riders on a train. Example: The conductor said, “All aboard!”
definitions.meaning2: A person who leads a band. Example: The conductor lifted her arms and the band began to play.
definitions.studentChallenge: The ___ checked each ticket on the train.

definitions.meaning1: Something that looks smudged or too fast to see clearly. Example: The trees were a blur from the car window.
definitions.meaning2: To make something hard to see clearly. Example: Tears can blur your eyes.
definitions.studentChallenge: The runners went by so fast they looked like a ___.

definitions.meaning1: A long path that goes under the ground or through a hill. Example: The train rushed into the dark tunnel.
definitions.meaning2: To dig a path under the ground. Example: A mole can tunnel under the garden.
definitions.studentChallenge: The cars drove through the long, dark ___ under the mountain.

definitions.meaning1: To move slowly with a low, puffing sound. Example: The little boat began to chug up the river.
definitions.studentChallenge: The old truck began to ___ up the steep hill.

definitions.meaning1: Land outside of towns and cities, with farms and fields. Example: We rode our bikes through the quiet countryside.
definitions.studentChallenge: Cows and green fields filled the ___.

definitions.meaning1: To move very fast with a buzzing sound. Example: The race cars whiz by.
definitions.meaning2: A person who is very good at something. Example: My sister is a math whiz.

definitions.meaning1: To make a short, hard, knocking sound. Example: His shoes clack on the hard floor.
definitions.meaning2: A short, hard sound. Example: We heard the clack of the keys.
definitions.studentChallenge: The wooden blocks ___ when they bump together.

definitions.meaning1: A car of a train where people sit. Example: We sat in the third carriage.
definitions.meaning2: A vehicle with wheels that a horse pulls. Example: The horse pulled the carriage down the road.
definitions.studentChallenge: We found our seats in the last ___ of the train.

definitions.meaning1: The little car at the very end of a long train. Example: The red caboose was the last car on the train.
definitions.studentChallenge: We waved to the worker in the ___ at the back of the train.

definitions.meaning1: Not moving or not being used. Example: The bus sat idle in the parking lot.
definitions.meaning2: To run slowly without going anywhere. Example: The car will idle at the red light.
definitions.studentChallenge: The swings were ___ because the park was empty.
